mentions.name: Correctify Design Studio
mentions.description: This tool turns plain restaurant menu text into menu designs based on the chosen size, style and branding. It takes a content-first approach, designing around the menu text itself rather than relying on draggable boxes or ill-fitting templates, with the goal of significantly lowering waiting times and costs for restaurant owners. It is currently in private beta.
mentions.problem: Traditional menu design involves dragging boxes around or fighting templates that don't fit the menu, which causes long waiting times and costs for restaurant owners.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Correctify's Design Studio, a feature that turns plain restaurant menu text into menu designs based on your choosen size, style and branding.
